MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Data Business Analyst

Shape the future of data-driven healthcare at Epworth

At Epworth, Every Patient Matters. We are looking for a highly capable Data Business Analyst to join our team and play a key role in advancing our journey towards becoming a truly data-driven organisation. Working closely with business leaders, technical teams and reporting analysts, you'll transform business challenges into practical data solutions that improve decision-making and deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Data and Decision Support, you will partner with stakeholders across the business to understand priorities, define requirements and design data solutions that support strategic objectives. You'll work at the intersection of business, technology and analytics, helping turn complex data into actionable insights that drive performance across Epworth

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Data Business Analyst who enjoys stakeholder engagement, solution design and project delivery in a collaborative healthcare environment.

You will:

Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define business problems and gather requirements

Translate business needs into clear user stories, process maps, business rules and technical documentation

Work closely with Reporting Analysts and Data Governance teams to develop meaningful reporting, KPIs and dashboards

Support solution design, business case development and data-led decision making

Contribute to project delivery across Agile and Waterfall environments

Facilitate testing, user acceptance activities and stakeholder engagement

Deliver training, documentation and support to improve data literacy across the organisation

Position Description Inherent Requirement

About You

You will be a highly capable and motivated professional with strong interpersonal, organisational and stakeholder management skills, supported by excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Self-motivated and adaptable, you will thrive in fast-paced environments, demonstrate sound judgement and integrity, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and be committed to continuous improvement, quality outcomes and exceptional customer service.

To be successful, you will have:

Tertiary qualifications in Business, Data, Information Systems or a related discipline

Business Analysis qualifications or equivalent experience

3+ years experience in Business Analyst roles, with strong background in healthcare

Strong requirements gathering, process mapping and stakeholder engagement skills

Experience exploring and validating data using SSMS, BigQuery or similar cloud data platforms

Knowledge of healthcare operations, performance drivers and reporting environments

Experience working within Agile and project delivery frameworks

Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences

Experience with dashboard and reporting development will be highly regarded

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact. If you're passionate about using data to drive better decisions and outcomes in healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

At Epworth, it's a community

It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation and a team that works to make sure that every patient matters. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

Relocation assistance is available for approved candidates

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. This includes First Nations peoples, people with disability, mature-age and young job seekers, members of the LGBTIQA+ community, and individuals from all cultural backgrounds. We are committed to providing an equitable, inclusive, and barrier-free recruitment experience for everyone.

If you need support during the application process or would like to discuss reasonable adjustments, we encourage you to let us know what you need to participate fully and confidently. We understand that sharing your needs can feel daunting, so please know that any information you provide will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and respect.

Apply now

As part of the application process, please also respond to the following selection criteria questions in your cover letter:

Key Selection Criteria Questions

What experience do you have working with healthcare data, hospital operations or healthcare performance reporting?

Have you used SQL, SSMS, BigQuery or similar tools to explore and validate data sources? Please provide an example.

What experience do you have working within Agile or project delivery environments?

Please advise your availability to commence employment and any notice period required.

Please outline your salary expectations (exclusive of superannuation).

For more information about the role, refer to the attached position description or contact talent@epworth.org.au or call (03) 9426 0606.

Ready to make a difference? Apply now and help us deliver smarter, data-driven healthcare solutions.

Apply now! Click I'm Interested and submit your CV and cover letter as a single document including brief responses to the selection criteria questions above.

Early applications are encouraged - shortlisting will commence immediately.

Apply now. we've over 8,000 perspectives at Epworth and we're ready to welcome yours!

It is a condition of employment with Epworth HealthCare, subject to reasonable exemptions, that you have had an annual Influenza vaccination, where this is required under Epworth policy.

As a child safe organisation, all successful applicants are required to satisfactorily clear a National Police Check (conducted by Epworth) and may be required to hold a valid employee Working with Children Check (provided by you).

4-Week Contract Role | Townsville   Your new company     This established Townsville-based organisation is undertaking a significant data quality and system improvement project to enhance the accuracy and consistency of its product catalogue and ERP system. With a strong focus on operational excellence and process improvement, the business is seeking a detail-oriented administrator to support this important initiative.    Your new role     As a Product Data Auditor, you will play a key role in reviewing, correcting, and standardising approximately 8,000 part records within a leading ERP system. This is a detail-focused role requiring accuracy, consistency, and the ability to maintain high-quality product data while following established standards and processes.     Your responsibilities will include:    
 
 Reviewing part records against an audit spreadsheet and established data standards   
 Updating and standardising product descriptions and naming conventions

Job Title: Sales Performance Analyst 
Position: Full-time 
Company: Khanz Auto Hub Pty Ltd
ABN: 69 643 572 632
Location: 345 Greensborough Road, Watsonia, Victoria, 3087
Salary: $79,000 – $81,000 per annum + guaranteed superannuation

About the Company
Khanz Auto Hub is a trusted used car dealership and fleet management service provider with showrooms in Watsonia and Thomastown in Melbourne, Victoria. We specialize in high-quality used vehicles and customized fleet and rental solutions. At Khanz Auto Hub, we work hard to provide our customers with the best used vehicles and exceptional service they can rely on. We ensure our customers leave our dealerships with a vehicle that perfectly suits their lifestyle and budget. 
For fleet management solutions, we cater to both small and large businesses, offering cost-effective rental and management services designed to optimize fleet performance. 
At Khanz Auto Hub, we strive to provide the best used vehicles and reliable after-sales maintenance services, ensuring comprehensive support for our customers. 

Position Description
We are currently seeking a qualified and experienced Sales Performance Analyst to join our team at Khanz Auto Hub. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in analysing sales performance data, inventory turnover, customer insights, and sales team metrics to drive data-informed decisions that optimise profitability, procurement, and overall business performance in our used vehicle dealership and fleet management operations.
The salary for this position ranges from $79,000 to $81,000 per year plus guaranteed superannuation, depending on qualifications, skills, and experience.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
1.	Analyse sales transaction data across hundreds of annual vehicle sales to identify patterns in vehicle turnover rates, profitability by vehicle type/age/source, pricing effectiveness, seasonal demand variations, customer purchasing behavior, and margin performance to inform procurement and inventory decisions.
2.	Consolidate data from sales transactions, vehicle purchases, refurbishment expenses, and customer records into organized databases enabling analysis of profitability and sales performance patterns.
3.	Analyze inventory turnover by vehicle type, identify slow-moving vehicles, and recommend which vehicle categories to purchase more or less to improve capital efficiency and reduce holding costs.
4.	Analyze refurbishment costs versus sale prices to determine how much to invest in repairs and improvements for different vehicle types to maximize profit margins.
5.	Prepare performance reports and dashboards presenting which vehicles sell best, procurement recommendations, pricing strategies, and sales forecasts to inform business decisions.
6.	Compare different vehicle sources (auctions, wholesale, trade-ins, direct purchases) by analyzing profit margins and sales speed to determine optimal allocation of the annual procurement budget.
7.	Analyze customer data to identify buyer segments (individual, business, fleet), their vehicle preferences and purchasing patterns to guide inventory selection strategies.
8.	Track and analyze sales representative performance metrics including conversion rates, average sale prices, margin achievement, product mix effectiveness, and customer satisfaction to identify best practices, training needs, and performance improvement opportunities.

Essential Requirements:
•	At least a bachelor’s degree or higher qualification.
•	At least 1 year of full-time work experience.
•	Strong analytical and quantitative skills with advanced Excel and experience in dashboards (Power BI, Tableau) and database management.
•	Ability to interpret and communicate complex data to non-technical stakeholders.
•	Experience analysing sales metrics, product performance, customer trends and pricing structures.
•	High attention to detail, accuracy and ability to prioritise multiple tasks.
•	Experience working with ERP/CRM systems and integrating data from multiple sources.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
